test_adaboost_classifier: test AdaBoostClassifier for classification on iris dataset with predict, predict_proba, and decision_function
test_adaboost_regressor: test AdaBoostRegressor for regression on diabetes dataset with linear, square, and exponential loss functions
test_staged_predictions: test staged_predict, staged_predict_proba, staged_decision_function, and staged_score for incremental predictions
test_sparse_input_handling: test AdaBoostClassifier and AdaBoostRegressor with sparse input formats CSC, CSR, LIL, COO, and DOK
test_feature_importance: test AdaBoostClassifier feature_importances_ with numerically stable small sample weights
